summaries.en: Qwen3.5-2B is a compact 2-billion-parameter multimodal model that accepts both text and image inputs and outputs conversational text. It starts from the Qwen3.5-2B-Base and is instruction-tuned, making it a lightweight option for practical image-text dialogue systems. Its strength lies in bringing capable vision-language performance to resource-constrained environments, with support for standard safetensors, Transformers, and cloud deployment via SageMaker or Azure. You can load it with Hugging Face Transformers, fine-tune further for your own tasks, or deploy it directly as an endpoint for a low-latency chat assistant.
